company.name: Singular Genomics
company.shortDescription: Singular Genomics is a biotech company focused on delivering genomic technologies for the advancement of science and medicine.
company.description: Singular Genomics is a life science technology company that is leveraging novel, next generation sequencing (NGS) and multiomics technologies to build products that empower researchers and clinicians. The Singular Sequencing Engine is the foundational platform technology that forms the basis of Singular Genomics’ products in development and Singular Genomics’ core product tenets: accuracy, speed, flexibility and scale. Singular Genomics’ first integrated solution is targeted at the NGS market and comprises an instrument and an associated menu of consumable kits, which Singular Genomics refers to collectively as the G4 Integrated Solution. A second integrated solution in development comprises an instrument and an associated menu of consumable kits, which Singular Genomics refers to collectively as the PX Integrated Solution. The PX Integrated Solution combines single cell analysis, spatial analysis, genomics and proteomics in one integrated instrument providing a versatile multiomics solution.

productsAndServices.description: An instrument and workflow for high-throughput in situ spatial multiomics, measuring RNA, proteins, and morphology in the same FFPE tissue section at subcellular resolution.
productsAndServices.name: G4X Spatial Sequencing Platform

productsAndServices.description: A technology-access service that generates spatial transcriptomic or multiomic data from customer tissue samples using the G4X platform, with sample processing, customized panels, and data analysis support.
productsAndServices.name: G4X Spatial Services

productsAndServices.description: RNA and protein assay-content services for selecting standard G4X panels or designing custom spatial panels for specific genes, proteins, tissues, and research applications.
productsAndServices.name: G4X Content and Panel Customization

productsAndServices.description: A benchtop NGS capability integrated into the G4X system for paired-read sequencing across whole-genome, exome, targeted, RNA, single-cell, and metagenomic applications.
productsAndServices.name: G4X Next-Generation Sequencing

aiResearchSummary.text: Singular Genomics is engaged in developing methods and compositions for sequencing nucleic acids, such as in 'Fluorinated nucleotides and uses thereof' and 'Nucleic acid sequencing-by-synthesis (sbs) methods that combine sbs cycle steps.' Their work includes devices and systems for sample analysis, as described in 'Flow cell receiver and methods of use' and 'Multiomic analysis device and methods of use thereof.' Research also covers amplification, detection, and spatial analysis of nucleic acids and proteins.
